S112.anchor: §Common params line 50 (`-c, --ctx-size`); §Server-specific params lines 165 (`--kv-unified-per-slot`), 169 (`--kv-unified`), 177 (`--parallel`); §GET `/props` lines 839-934 (default_generation_settings bullet 927, total_slots bullet 928); §GET `/slots` lines 983-1126 (n_ctx example values at 999 and 1064); §GET `/v1/models` line 1304 (meta.n_ctx_train); §POST `/completion` generation_settings bullet 671 and truncated bullet 683; raw file sha256 714c067bdbc49bde2735810fbff83eb2933b12c57d50f0012b61fcecb75a6a37
S112.teaches: The only pool-sizing promise in the README is `--kv-unified-per-slot`: when set without `-c`/`--ctx-size`, the shared KV pool is sized to n_parallel*N. Otherwise n_ctx appears only as fields: `-c` is "size of the prompt context (default: 0, 0 = loaded from model)"; `--kv-unified` is "single unified KV buffer shared across all sequences (default: enabled if number of slots is auto)"; `--parallel` is "number of server slots (default: -1, -1 = auto)"; `/props` default_generation_settings "has the same fields as the generation_settings response object from the /completion endpoint" (which includes n_ctx); `/props` total_slots is "defined by --parallel"; `/slots` returns per-slot state including n_ctx (example values only); `/v1/models` meta.n_ctx_train is the training context; /completion truncated defines n_ctx as the context size exceeded when tokens_evaluated plus tokens_predicted exceed it. The README does not define n_ctx in /props or /slots as per-slot or pool-level, does not state how an unset (0) context divides across slots, does not state the served n_ctx for any -c/-np/kv-unified combination, and never mentions the KV pool size in any HTTP surface.
